records.jp: そういえば勇希と伶那さん、どこ行ったの？<CR>全然教室に戻ってこないけど
records.en_original: Hey, where did Yuki and Rena go? They've been gone for a while.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, where did Yuki and Rena go? They've been gone for a while.
records.en: Come to think of it, where did Yuki and Rena-san go?<CR>They haven't come back to the classroom at all.

records.jp: ふっふっふ。<CR>二人は今日はおデートなのです
records.en_original: Hehehe. Those two are on a date.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe. Those two are on a date.
records.en: Heh heh heh.<CR>Those two are on a date today.

records.jp: はぁ～っ……<CR>空はこんなに晴れてるってのに……
records.en_original: Ugh... What a waste of a beautiful day.
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh... What a waste of a beautiful day.
records.en: Haaah...<CR>Even though the sky is so clear...

records.jp: なに、急に
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What brought that on?

records.jp: つまんなーい！　どんなにいい天気でも、<CR>毎日毎日、見るのは学校の景色だけ！
records.en_original: I'm bored! No matter how nice the weather is, all we ever see are the same old school grounds!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm bored! No matter how nice the weather is, all we ever see are the same old school grounds!
records.en: I'm booorred! No matter how nice the weather is,<CR>every single day, all we see is the school scenery!

records.jp: 出かけるといったら、ココロトープだし……。<CR>どっか別のところにパーッと遊びに行きたーい！
records.en_original: The only other place we go is the Heartscape. I just want to go somewhere new!
records.en_auxiliary: The only other place we go is the Heartscape. I just want to go somewhere new!
records.en: And whenever we go out, it's to the Heartscape...<CR>I wanna go somewhere else and have a blast!

records.jp: ふーん……そんなにつまんないんだ
records.en_original: Mm... You're that bored, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... You're that bored, huh?
records.en: Hmm... You're that bored?

records.jp: 私が隣にいても、いなくても、<CR>あんまり変わらないってことか
records.en_original: So me being with you doesn't really make a difference one way or another?
records.en_auxiliary: So me being with you doesn't really make a difference one way or another?
records.en: So whether I'm beside you or not,<CR>it doesn't make much difference?

records.jp: ……！？　なっ……ちっ、違うからっ！<CR>あたしは別に、そんなつもりで言ったわけじゃ……
records.en_original: Wh-wha—?! N-no, that's not what I was saying at all!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-wha—?! N-no, that's not what I was saying at all!
records.en: ...!? Th-that's... That's not it!<CR>That isn't what I meant when I said it...

records.jp: ……あっ！？<CR>今、笑っ……ひっど！　騙したなーっ！！
records.en_original: ...Huh?! A-are you laughing?! Oh, that is so mean! You tricked me!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Huh?! A-are you laughing?! Oh, that is so mean! You tricked me!
records.en: ...Ah!?<CR>You just laughed... That's awful! You tricked me!!

records.jp: （あ、勇希と伶那さんだ。<CR>あ、でもデート中だっけ。話しかけたら悪いよね）
records.en_original: (Oh, there's Yuki and Rena. Oh, wait. They're on a date. I shouldn't bother them.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh, there's Yuki and Rena. Oh, wait. They're on a date. I shouldn't bother them.)
records.en: (Ah, it's Yuki and Rena-san.<CR>Oh, but they're on a date. It'd be rude to talk to them.)

records.jp: ひどい？　騙した？　私が？
records.en_original: Mean? You think I tricked you?
records.en_auxiliary: Mean? You think I tricked you?
records.en: Awful? Tricked you? Me?

records.jp: （……って、ヤバいとこに来ちゃった！？）
records.en_original: (Oh crap! What have I walked in on?!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh crap! What have I walked in on?!)
records.en: (Wait, did I walk in at a really bad time!?)

records.jp: 嘘が苦手で、冗談すら言えなかった伶那はどこ！？<CR>一体どこでそんなやり方を学んで……
records.en_original: Where's the Rena that I used to know?! The one who couldn't even tell a joke, let alone a lie! Where did you learn to be like that?!
records.en_auxiliary: Where's the Rena that I used to know?! The one who couldn't even tell a joke, let alone a lie! Where did you learn to be like that?!
records.en: Where's the Rena who was bad at lying and couldn't even joke!?<CR>Where in the world did you learn to do that...?

records.jp: あんたの真似だけど？
records.en_original: I'm just acting like you, Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just acting like you, Yuki.
records.en: I was imitating you, though?

records.jp: でっ……でもっ、今日のは伶那が悪いっ！<CR>オトメのハートを弄んだっ！
records.en_original: B-but... Don't try to pin this on me, Rena, this one's on you! Quit playing with my heart!
records.en_auxiliary: B-but... Don't try to pin this on me, Rena, this one's on you! Quit playing with my heart!
records.en: B-but today, Rena's in the wrong!<CR>You toyed with a maiden's heart!

records.jp: じゃあ、第三者にジャッジしてもらう？<CR>どっちがより悪いのか
records.en_original: Well, how about we get a third party to judge who's in the wrong here?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, how about we get a third party to judge who's in the wrong here?
records.en: Then how about we have a third party judge<CR>which of us is more in the wrong?

records.jp: さっきからそこをウロウロしてる、星崎さんにね
records.en_original: Hoshizaki's been pacing around back there for a bit now, we can ask her.
records.en_auxiliary: Hoshizaki's been pacing around back there for a bit now, we can ask her.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, who's been wandering around over there for a while.

records.jp: 二人とも、ごめん！　邪魔するつもりは全然なくて、<CR>ここに来たのは、本当にたまたまっていうか……！
records.en_original: I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to eavesdrop! I really was just passing through, and...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to eavesdrop! I really was just passing through, and...
records.en: I'm sorry, both of you! I had no intention of interrupting.<CR>I really just happened to come here...!

records.jp: むしろいい感じのデートスポットをなるべく<CR>外したつもりで散歩してて……！
records.en_original: To be honest, I was trying to avoid all the places I thought seemed like good date spots, but...!
records.en_auxiliary: To be honest, I was trying to avoid all the places I thought seemed like good date spots, but...!
records.en: If anything, I was taking a walk while trying to avoid<CR>any place that looked like a good date spot...!

records.jp: そんなのわかってるから、早くジャッジ
records.en_original: Sure, sure. Can you just pass judgment already?
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, sure. Can you just pass judgment already?
records.en: We know that, so hurry up and judge.

records.jp: はいっ！　すみません！
records.en_original: R-right! Sorry!
records.en_auxiliary: R-right! Sorry!
records.en: Yes! Sorry!

records.jp: （とはいえ、話を聞いた感じ、どっちもどっちだし。<CR>……どうせなら反応が面白そうな方を選んじゃお！）
records.en_original: (From what I heard, they're both to blame... I wonder whose reaction would be funnier?)
records.en_auxiliary: (From what I heard, they're both to blame... I wonder whose reaction would be funnier?)
records.en: (Still, from what I heard, they're both as bad as each other.<CR>...If I'm choosing anyway, I'll pick whoever's reaction looks funnier!)

records.jp: 話を聞いてた感じ、勇希が悪いと思います！
records.en_original: From what I heard, it sounds like Yuki is in the wrong!
records.en_auxiliary: From what I heard, it sounds like Yuki is in the wrong!
records.en: From what I heard, I think Yuki's in the wrong!

records.jp: えーっ！？　そんなぁー！
records.en_original: What?! No way!
records.en_auxiliary: What?! No way!
records.en: Whaaat!? No way!

records.jp: 当然のジャッジでしょ
records.en_original: Seems like a fair judgment to me.
records.en_auxiliary: Seems like a fair judgment to me.
records.en: It's the obvious judgment.

records.jp: でもさー、私が思うにこれって、もう嘘はつくな、素直<CR>に気持ちを伝えろっていう伶那さんの本音の表れ……
records.en_original: But if you ask me, I think that this was Rena's way of telling you to stop hiding behind jokes and be honest about your feelings…
records.en_auxiliary: But if you ask me, I think that this was Rena's way of telling you to stop hiding behind jokes and be honest about your feelings…
records.en: But if you ask me, I think this is Rena-san's way of saying:<CR>stop lying and be honest about how you feel...

records.jp: そっ、そういえば私、散歩の途中なんだった！<CR>じゃあね、二人とも！
records.en_original: A-anyway, I just remembered that I was in the middle of a walk! Bye!
records.en_auxiliary: A-anyway, I just remembered that I was in the middle of a walk! Bye!
records.en: N-now that I think of it, I was in the middle of a walk!<CR>See you, you two!

records.jp: えっと……。あ、あたしってば、<CR>ものすごーく愛されちゃってる的な！？　あはは……
records.en_original: S-so, uh... I guess that means I'm loved, huh? Eheheh...
records.en_auxiliary: S-so, uh... I guess that means I'm loved, huh? Eheheh...
records.en: Um... D-does that mean I'm,<CR>like, suuuuper loved!? Ahaha...

records.jp: ……そんなの、とっくに知ってるでしょ
records.en_original: You know the answer to that.
records.en_auxiliary: You know the answer to that.
records.en: ...You already knew that a long time ago, didn't you?

records.en_original: Ah... Y-yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... Y-yeah...
records.en: Ah...<CR>...Y-yeah...

records.jp: 話を聞く感じ、伶那さんが悪い気がします！<CR>正確に言うと、意地が悪いと思います！
records.en_original: From what I heard, I feel like Rena is in the wrong! I think it was very mean-spirited of you!
records.en_auxiliary: From what I heard, I feel like Rena is in the wrong! I think it was very mean-spirited of you!
records.en: From what I heard, I feel like Rena-san is in the wrong!<CR>More precisely, I think you were being mean!

records.jp: 好きな子に悪戯したくなっちゃう的な心理かも<CR>しれないけどさー、もっと素直にイチャついた方が……
records.en_original: I mean, I understand wanting to tease the one you love, but can't you just make out or—
records.en_auxiliary: I mean, I understand wanting to tease the one you love, but can't you just make out or—
records.en: Maybe it's that urge to tease the girl you like,<CR>but I think it'd be better to flirt more honestly...

records.jp: ……っ、ちょっと！　星崎さん！
records.en_original: H-hey! Hoshizaki?!
records.en_auxiliary: H-hey! Hoshizaki?!
records.en: ...! Hey! Hoshizaki-san!

records.jp: あっ……！　と、とにかくジャッジはしたんで！<CR>お邪魔しましたーっ！
records.en_original: Oh! Umm... I think my work here is done! Bye!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh! Umm... I think my work here is done! Bye!
records.en: Ah...! A-anyway, I made my judgment!<CR>Sorry for intruding!

records.jp: 好きな子に悪戯したくなっちゃう的なやつだったんだ？
records.en_original: So you just wanted to tease me because you love me, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: So you just wanted to tease me because you love me, huh?
records.en: So it was that thing where you wanted to tease the girl you like?

records.jp: この……急にしたり顔で……
records.en_original: Ugh... What do you look so smug about?
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh... What do you look so smug about?
records.en: You... suddenly looking so smug...

records.jp: ……でも、別にいいか。<CR>そういう顔を見られるなら、結構悪くない
records.en_original: Well, whatever. I suppose it's all worth it if I get to see another side of you like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, whatever. I suppose it's all worth it if I get to see another side of you like this.
records.en: ...But maybe that's fine.<CR>If I get to see that kind of face, it's not so bad.

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ……あんたには退屈な毎日かもしれないけど
records.en_original: It may be boring for you, but...
records.en_auxiliary: It may be boring for you, but...
records.en: ...These days may be boring to you, but...

records.jp: 私にとっては、勇希と一緒に過ごせる、<CR>何よりも大切な日々だから。それは覚えといて
records.en_original: To me, these ordinary days I get to spend with you have been the most precious time of my life. Just keep that in mind.
records.en_auxiliary: To me, these ordinary days I get to spend with you have been the most precious time of my life. Just keep that in mind.
records.en: To me, the days I can spend with Yuki<CR>are more precious than anything. Remember that.

records.jp: うん。そうだね。……ありがと、伶那
records.en_original: I will. Thank you, Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: I will. Thank you, Rena.
records.en: Yeah. You're right. ...Thanks, Rena.
